state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q2: What home-office equipment allowance applied to a regular employee on 2026-03-15? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the flight fare limit for a standard return flight within Europe with checked equipment today? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q4: What is the monthly parking allowance for a city-centre employee with an assigned company parking space today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the nightly lodging limit for a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q6: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.

passages.source: HB-16 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-03-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-63
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 350 EUR. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet. Each claim for the home-office equipment allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-63 §4 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-16
passages.text: Group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance are published in HB-46. Claims for the home-office equipment allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Remote work: home-office equipment'. Managers confirm claims for the home-office equipment allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-63 §2 | Remote work: home-office equipment — Standard home-office equipment allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-16
passages.text: Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 400 EUR. The facilities reviews the home-office equipment allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Each claim for the home-office equipment allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-46 §1 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance in HB-63. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet. Questions about the home-office equipment allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-39 §1 | Related budgets: home-office equipment — Scope | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the home-office equipment allowance. Managers confirm claims for the home-office equipment allowance before payment in the next payroll run. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet.
